submission.justification: Algorithm-L3 at a threshold of 30 GeV yields the highest signal efficiency among all candidate algorithms and thresholds tested (92.8%), while remaining within the allowed threshold range (20–60 GeV). This choice maximizes signal efficiency for the Level-1 trigger, complying with all project constraints and goals.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L3 is among the tested candidate algorithms.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be deployable in the Level-1 trigger hardware.
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L3 was considered as a candidate for Level-1; candidate_specs.md and project simulation confirm deployability.
The recommended threshold is 30 GeV, within the 20-60 GeV range.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended algorithm and threshold.
requirements.evidence: Only Algorithm-L3 at 30 GeV is recommended in this submission.
